input.text: The release adds offline sync. Offline sync keeps drafts on the device, and sync resumes when the network returns. Drafts are encrypted at rest.
Checkout failed for twelve minutes after a database failover. The failover promoted a replica that lagged, so checkout requests timed out until the database caught up.
Retrieval quality improved when chunks overlapped. Overlapping chunks kept answers intact, and retrieval recall rose by nine points on the benchmark.
Customers cannot reset passwords from the mobile app. The reset link opens the browser instead of the app, so customers see a login loop.
Travel expenses need a receipt. Expenses above two hundred euros also need a manager approval, and approval must happen before the trip.
